text:
I have been going for a few years now as well as all my family members: 2 sons and a husband.

🚗 The staff is professional, friendly and kind. The clinic is easy to find and has parking spaces nearby.

🏥 The clinic itself is very clean, very comfortable and with the latest equipments. It looks luxury but with affordable prices I feel.

My older son have had there diamond metal braces there and all went smoothly.

My younger son has been treated for molar tooth decay and has been feeling very confident and relaxed going there.

As for my husband and myself, we have been going for all things like tooth cleaning, check ups, crowns, and today for me tooth extraction and implant.

💉 For my tooth extraction and dental implant, I had a first consultation with Dr Phung whom explained me in details the procedure, the budget and the timeline.

✨ She has a very good English so very easy to communicate (my thai is too basic!). But what struck me the most is that she is very calm, very professional and makes you feel at ease. I was scared and stressed about the procedures: she explained me what she was doing for each step to reassure me, describing which sensations will come which each step. Really something to be highlighted here as this is not common in Thailand.

✨ So overall highly recommended ✨
